description: From below the town walls the castle of the Dukes of Alburquerque crowns the Cuéllar hilltop as a dark moonlit silhouette, its crenellated towers catching the night light above the town. Warm lights glow at its base and spread down through the old town, while the cloudy night sky keeps the scene quiet and still. The fortress — Gothic and Renaissance over a medieval core, a National Monument since 1931 — presides over the village much as it has for centuries.

prompts.prompt-r1.txt: Photorealistic long-exposure night photograph of Cuéllar Castle (Castle of the Dukes of Alburquerque), Spain, viewed from below the town walls. IMPORTANT: the castle is completely dark and unlit — a moonlit silhouette with crenellated walls and towers, the Mudéjar brickwork catching faint moonlight. Warm town lights glow at the base and below in the town of Cuéllar. Cloudy dark night sky with stars. Deep night mood. No identifiable people prominent. Subject centred so it survives a 4:5 centre crop. No text or brand logos anywhere, no on-image text at all.
